sample_spherical_gaussian_noise: sample Gaussian Process noise on a sphere with a given power spectrum using the sample function
create_grid_for_nodal_data: create a Grid for spherical harmonic transforms from xarray nodal data with lat and lon dimensions
compute_noise_schedule: compute a descending noise schedule for diffusion sampling using the rho distribution with configurable parameters
apply_stochastic_churn: apply stochastic churn to increase noise level of data before denoising in a diffusion sampling step
sample_spherical_white_noise: sample isotropic mean zero variance one white noise on the sphere matching a template dataset shape
